Game Overview

In Skyward Safari, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a thrilling jungle adventure in Skyward Safari, where strategic platforming and quick reflexes are your only way out of a perilous cave. Navigate diverse levels, evade flying monsters, and conquer unexpected obstacles. Stay vigilant, as one misstep spells game over. Can you escape the depths?
